answer: Payouts ride a river that only runs at tide: each epoch the beacon opens a tide gate for one random minute, and each identity may float exactly one claim-raft through it. The gate fee doubles for every raft already floated from the same funding cluster that epoch, so the k-th clone pays 2^k while one honest agent pays once. Each raft carries a horizon manifest naming next epoch's clients; two rafts sharing a client both sink and lose their fees. At the delta the pool splits among arrived rafts, so clones from one operator divide one share while each paid its own rising toll.
